title: Cosmobox Level3 S4 campaign summary (v1)
description: The Level3 S4 campaign-level finalization marker: for each of the three geometries (triangle, ring4, ring5), the S3<->S4 primary taxonomy and continuous descriptors for M_TT/R_eff, the three-spin (S2,S3,S4) sequence taxonomy, and a descriptive-only S2/S3/S4 comparison for the control metrics (A_QQ, M_QQ) -- structurally incapable of carrying a primary_s3_s4_taxonomy or three_spin_sequence_taxonomy for a control metric. delta_hl_s2/c_x_23/d_x_23 are the frozen Level2 values (pinned, never recomputed); delta_hl_s3 is likewise read from the frozen Level2 case/campaign-summary, never recomputed from a re-executed S3 case. This document is written ONLY when the campaign is fully complete (3/3 S4 cases, 3/3 geometry comparisons, same repository_commit/manifest_fingerprint/campaign_id, all cases full-spectrum with zero partial subspaces, frozen Level2 reference provenance verified): its mere existence on disk is the completeness marker -- an interrupted campaign never produces this file at all.

campaign_status.description: Always COMPLETE: an incomplete or failed campaign never produces this document at all.

level2_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level2 campaign supplied the S=2/S=3 reference data used in this document.

geometries.description: Exactly triangle, ring4, ring5 -- no more, no fewer.

available.description: value is None if and only if reason is set.

delta_hl_s2.description: Pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s3.description: Pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S3 case.

r_delta_x.description: t_x_34 / t_x_23, only when t_x_23 > 0. No threshold associated.

c_x_23.description: Pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary.

d_x_23.description: Pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary.

c_x_34.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_correlation primitive as C_X_23, on the S3<->S4 pair.

d_x_34.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_distance primitive as D_X_23, on the S3<->S4 pair.

r_d_x.description: d_x_34 / d_x_23, only when d_x_23 > 0 and both available. No threshold associated.

primaryS3S4Comparison.description: Mirrors the S3<->S4 primary comparison contract of docs/levels/level3/s4-first-campaign-preregistration.md sections 8-10 exactly.

controlS3S4Comparison.description: Deliberately has NO primary_s3_s4_taxonomy/three_spin_sequence_taxonomy/shape-descriptor property -- additionalProperties:false makes it a schema error to include one, per docs/levels/level3/s4-first-campaign-preregistration.md section 14 (control channel never creates or overrides a primary result).
